patterns.message: An island entry graph must not import the SPA router or the workbook store — an island mounts with neither. The item stores are refused by the island build instead, which sees the graph after types are erased, so `import type` from them stays fine.

paths.name: vue-router
paths.message: An island mounts without a router instance, so its graph must not depend on one.

patterns.message: The view surface is what an island mounts, so it must reach none of the modules an island refuses: the SPA router, the item stores, or a socket of its own. A builder source is where a store belongs — see dashboard/builder.ts.

paths.name: vue-router
paths.message: The view surface mounts without a router instance. Name a route and let `helpers/navigation` resolve it.
